text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka achieved an impressive victory at the Kinko Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: News spreads like wildfire, and her interview the next day is packed with reporters.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um… Thank you all for coming today…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Click, click, click, click…

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: With this milestone victory now behind you, what are you planning for the future? Will you be entering the G1 races?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Many people refer to you as the "Otherworldly Front-Runner." What are your thoughts about the moniker?

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text: Who do you regard as your biggest rival?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: U-um… Well…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (Can this just be over already so I can train!)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Phew…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: That press conference was too much excitement for me. I feel so much better out here on the track.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: No, it's not that. I just… don't think I'm very good at them.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: If it were up to me, I'd spend all my time running… It's not easy being a racer, I suppose…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hehe. That's very like you, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh, hi, Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Do you have a moment? I have something I want to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, I have some time. What is it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You ran very well yesterday at the Kinko Sho.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ever since you entered the academy, you've always focused on your love for running.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: And now, to see you become this widely celebrated… It makes me feel proud.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You were truly spectacular out there.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Your drive and determination to win is inspiring—not to mention your overwhelming speed.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Everyone was holding their breath as they watched you push faster and faster.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I think it's safe to say you've become the new ideal for many Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You're exaggerating…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka tries to downplay the praise, but Air Groove grabs her shoulders gently.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Suzuka, I swear I'll defeat you one day.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I must.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Air Groove…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I… I understand.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh. I'm grateful to you for giving me such drive as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'll be running in the next Grand Prix race, the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'll see you on the turf!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove holds out her right hand, and the two of them exchange a firm shake.
